context_title:
Build a complete, production-ready protein structure prediction system in Julia, implemented across at most 15 single Julia source files. Every file must be complete and unabridged — no placeholders, no stubs, no simplified mock implementations. All logic described below must be fully implemented.

---

## File 1: `constants.jl`

Define all biological and chemical constants used throughout the system.

- Define the 20 standard amino acid three-letter codes as interned symbols: `ALA`, `ARG`, `ASN`, `ASP`, `CYS`, `GLN`, `GLU`, `GLY`, `HIS`, `ILE`, `LEU`, `LYS`, `MET`, `PHE`, `PRO`, `SER`, `THR`, `TRP`, `TYR`, `VAL`, plus `UNK`, `GAP` (`-`), `UNL`, `MSE`.
- Define `PROTEIN_TYPES` (20 standard), `PROTEIN_TYPES_WITH_UNKNOWN` (21), `PROTEIN_TYPES_WITH_UNKNOWN_AND_GAP` (22).
- Define one-letter to three-letter and three-letter to one-letter amino acid mappings as `Dict{Char,String}` and `Dict{String,Char}`.
- Define nucleotide types: RNA (`A`, `C`, `G`, `U`) and DNA (`DA`, `DC`, `DG`, `DT`), plus `DN` (unknown DNA), `N` (unknown RNA).
- Define `POLYMER_TYPES` as the union of protein, RNA, and DNA types plus unknowns and gap.
- Define `POLYMER_TYPES_NUM_WITH_UNKNOWN_AND_GAP` as the integer count of all polymer types.
- Define mmCIF chain type string constants: `PROTEIN_CHAIN = "polypeptide(L)"`, `RNA_CHAIN = "polyribonucleotide"`, `DNA_CHAIN = "polydeoxyribonucleotide"`, `BRANCHED_CHAIN = "branched"`, `NON_POLYMER_CHAIN = "non-polymer"`, `WATER = "water"`, `MACROLIDE_CHAIN = "macrolide"`, `OTHER_CHAIN = "other"`, `CYCLIC_PSEUDO_PEPTIDE_CHAIN = "cyclic-pseudo-peptide"`, `DNA_RNA_HYBRID_CHAIN = "polydeoxyribonucleotide/polyribonucleotide hybrid"`, `PEPTIDE_NUCLEIC_ACID_CHAIN = "peptide nucleic acid"`, `POLYPEPTIDE_D_CHAIN = "polypeptide(D)"`.
- Define `STANDARD_POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES`, `LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES`, `POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES` as sets of the above strings.
- Define `ATOM37` as a tuple of 37 atom name strings: `N, CA, C, CB, O, CG, CG1, CG2, OG, OG1, SG, CD, CD1, CD2, ND1, ND2, OD1, OD2, SD, CE, CE1, CE2, CE3, NE, NE1, NE2, OE1, OE2, CH2, NH1, NH2, OH, CZ, CZ2, CZ3, NZ, OXT`. Define `ATOM37_ORDER` as a `Dict{String,Int}`.
- Define `ATOM14` as a `Dict{String, Vector{String}}` mapping each of the 20 amino acids to their up-to-14 heavy atom names.
- Define `DENSE_ATOM` as a `Dict{String, Vector{String}}` mapping each nucleotide residue name to its heavy atom names.
- Define `CHI_ANGLES_ATOMS` as a `Dict{String, Vector{NTuple{4,String}}}` mapping each amino acid to its chi-angle atom quadruples (as in the reference: ALA and GLY have empty lists; ARG has 4 chi angles; etc.).
- Define the full periodic table as a struct `Element` with fields `number::Int`, `symbol::String`, `name::String`, `weight::Float64`. Define `PERIODIC_TABLE` as a `Vector{Element}` with all 118 elements plus element 0 (unknown, symbol `X`). Define `ATOMIC_NUMBER::Dict{String,Int}` and `ATOMIC_WEIGHT::Vector{Float64}` (indexed by atomic number). Add `ATOMIC_NUMBER["D"] = 1`.
- Define `COMMON_CRYSTALLIZATION_AIDS` as a `Set{String}` containing: `SO4, GOL, EDO, PO4, ACT, PEG, DMS, TRS, PGE, PG4, FMT, EPE, MPD, MES, CD, IOD`.
- Define `GLYCAN_LINKING_LIGANDS` and `GLYCAN_OTHER_LIGANDS` as `Set{String}` (populate with the standard PDB glycan residue codes for linking and non-linking saccharides respectively).
- Define a function `guess_polymer_type(chain_type::String)::String` that maps mmCIF entity poly type strings to one of `PROTEIN_CHAIN`, `RNA_CHAIN`, `DNA_CHAIN`, or throws an error.

## File 2: `cif_parser.jl`

Implement a complete mmCIF/CIF file parser in pure Julia.

- Define a struct `CifDict` wrapping a `Dict{String, Vector{String}}`. Implement `Base.getindex`, `Base.get`, `Base.haskey`, `Base.keys`, `Base.length`, `Base.iterate`.
- Implement `from_string(cif_string::Union{String,Vector{UInt8}})::CifDict` that fully parses a CIF file: tokenize the input (handling quoted strings with `'` and `"`, semicolon-delimited text blocks, comments starting with `#`), then parse `data_`, `loop_`, and key-value pairs into the dict.
- Implement `parse_multi_data_cif(cif_string::Union{String,Vector{UInt8}})::Dict{String,CifDict}` that parses a multi-block CIF file and returns one `CifDict` per `data_` block, keyed by the block name.
- Implement `extract_loop_as_list(cif::CifDict, prefix::String)::Vector{Dict{String,String}}` that extracts all fields sharing the given prefix into a list of row dicts.
- Implement `extract_loop_as_dict(cif::CifDict, prefix::String, index::String)::Dict{String,Dict{String,String}}` that extracts the loop indexed by the given field.
- Implement `to_string(cif::CifDict)::String` that serializes a `CifDict` back to a valid CIF string.
- Implement `get_data_name(cif::CifDict)::String` returning the `data_` block name stored internally.
- Implement `to_dict(cif::CifDict)::Dict{String,Vector{String}}` returning a plain dict copy.
- Implement `int_id_to_str_id(num::Int)::String` encoding a positive integer as a reverse-spreadsheet-style string (1→"A", 2→"B", ..., 27→"AA", 28→"BA", ...).
- Implement `str_id_to_int_id(str_id::String)::Int` as the inverse.
- Implement `get_release_date(cif::CifDict)::Union{Date,Nothing}` extracting `_pdbx_database_status.recvd_initial_deposition_date` or `_entry.id`-based date fields.
- Implement `get_internal_to_author_chain_id_map(cif::CifDict)::Dict{String,String}` mapping `_atom_site.label_asym_id` to `_atom_site.auth_asym_id`.

## File 3: `structure.jl`

Implement the full molecular structure representation.

- Define immutable structs `ChainsTable`, `ResiduesTable`, `AtomsTable`, `BondsTable`, each as frozen collections of equal-length `Vector` columns:
  - `ChainsTable`: `key::Vector{Int64}`, `id::Vector{String}`, `type::Vector{String}`, `auth_id::Vector{String}`, `entity_id::Vector{String}`, `entity_desc::Vector{String}`.
  - `ResiduesTable`: `key::Vector{Int64}`, `chain_key::Vector{Int64}`, `id::Vector{Int}`, `name::Vector{String}`, `auth_seq_id::Vector{String}`, `insertion_code::Vector{String}`, `is_missing::Vector{Bool}`.
  - `AtomsTable`: `key::Vector{Int64}`, `chain_key::Vector{Int64}`, `res_key::Vector{Int64}`, `name::Vector{String}`, `element::Vector{String}`, `x::Vector{Float32}`, `y::Vector{Float32}`, `z::Vector{Float32}`, `b_factor::Vector{Float32}`, `occupancy::Vector{Float32}`.
  - `BondsTable`: `key::Vector{Int64}`, `from_atom_key::Vector{Int64}`, `dest_atom_key::Vector{Int64}`, `type::Vector{String}`, `role::Vector{String}`.
- Define `struct Structure` with fields: `name::String`, `release_date::Union{Date,Nothing}`, `resolution::Union{Float64,Nothing}`, `structure_method::Union{String,Nothing}`, `chains::ChainsTable`, `residues::ResiduesTable`, `atoms::AtomsTable`, `bonds::BondsTable`.
- Implement `from_mmcif(mmcif_string::Union{String,Vector{UInt8}}; name=nothing, fix_mse_residues=false, fix_arginines=false, fix_unknown_dna=false, include_water=false, include_other=false, include_bonds=false, model_id=:first)::Structure` that:
  - Parses the mmCIF using `from_string`.
  - Resolves alternate locations by occupancy (keep highest occupancy, break ties by first occurrence).
  - Builds `ChainsTable` from `_entity_poly`, `_entity`, `_struct_asym` tables.
  - Builds `ResiduesTable` from `_entity_poly_seq` (for polymers) and `_atom_site` (for non-polymers), including missing residues.
  - Builds `AtomsTable` from `_atom_site`, filtering by `model_id`.
  - Optionally builds `BondsTable` from `_struct_conn`.
  - Applies `fix_mse_residues` (SE→SD in MSE), `fix_arginines` (swap NH1/NH2 if needed), `fix_unknown_dna` (N→DN in DNA chains).
- Implement `to_mmcif_dict(struc::Structure)::CifDict` that serializes the structure back to a complete mmCIF dict including all standard tables.
- Implement `filter_structure(struc::Structure; chain_ids=nothing, res_names=nothing, atom_names=nothing, chain_types=nothing)::Structure`.
- Implement `iter_chains(struc::Structure)`, `iter_residues(struc::Structure, chain_key::Int64)`, `iter_atoms(struc::Structure, res_key::Int64)` as iterators.
- Implement `chain_single_letter_sequence(struc::Structure, chain_key::Int64)::String` returning the one-letter sequence for a polymer chain.
- Implement `copy_and_update_coords(struc::Structure, coords::Matrix{Float32})::Structure` replacing atom x/y/z.

  - `Base.:-(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)::Vec3Array`

  - `cross(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array)::Vec3Array`
  - `norm(v::Vec3Array)::AbstractArray{Float32}`
  - `normalized(v::Vec3Array)::Vec3Array`
  - `square_euclidean_distance(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array; epsilon=1f-6)::AbstractArray{Float32}`
  - `euclidean_distance(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array; epsilon=1f-6)::AbstractArray{Float32}`
  - `dihedral_angle(a::Vec3Array, b::Vec3Array, c::Vec3Array, d::Vec3Array)::AbstractArray{Float32}`

  - `Base.:*(r::Rot3Array, v::Vec3Array)::Vec3Array` (apply rotation to vector)
  - `Base.:*(a::Rot3Array, b::Rot3Array)::Rot3Array` (compose rotations)
  - `inverse(r::Rot3Array)::Rot3Array` (transpose)

  - `Base.:*(a::Rigid3Array, b::Rigid3Array)::Rigid3Array`
  - `inverse(r::Rigid3Array)::Rigid3Array`
  - `apply_to_point(r::Rigid3Array, p::Vec3Array)::Vec3Array`
  - `from_point_alignment(mobile::Vec3Array, target::Vec3Array)::Rigid3Array` using SVD-based alignment
  - `identity_rigid3(shape)::Rigid3Array`
- Implement `unstack(arr::AbstractArray, dim::Int)::Vector{AbstractArray}` splitting along a dimension.
- Implement `angdiff(alpha::AbstractArray, beta::AbstractArray)::AbstractArray` computing the signed angular difference wrapped to `[-π, π]`.
- Implement `weighted_mean(values::AbstractArray, weights::AbstractArray; dim=nothing)::AbstractArray`.

## File 6: `msa.jl`

Implement Multiple Sequence Alignment processing.

- Define `struct Msa` with fields `query_sequence::String`, `chain_poly_type::String`, `sequences::Vector{String}`, `descriptions::Vector{String}`.
- Implement `Msa(query_sequence, chain_poly_type, sequences, descriptions; deduplicate=true)` constructor that:
  - Deduplicates sequences by removing lowercase letters (insertions) before comparison.
  - Ensures the first sequence matches the query (after featurization equivalence check).
  - Falls back to `[query_sequence]` / `["Original query"]` if empty.
- Implement `from_a3m(a3m_str::String, query_sequence::String, chain_poly_type::String)::Msa` parsing A3M format.
- Implement `to_a3m(msa::Msa)::String` serializing to A3M.
- Implement `lazy_parse_fasta(fasta_string::String)` returning an iterator of `(sequence::String, description::String)` tuples.
- Implement `parse_fasta(fasta_string::String)::Vector{Tuple{String,String}}`.
- Implement `convert_a3m_to_stockholm(a3m_sequences::Vector{String})::Vector{String}` converting A3M to Stockholm format by expanding insertions into gap-padded columns.
- Implement `extract_msa_features(msa_sequences::Vector{String}, chain_poly_type::String)::Tuple{Matrix{Int32}, Matrix{Int32}}` returning:
  - MSA integer array of shape `(num_seq, num_res)` encoding residue types (uppercase only).
  - Deletion count array of shape `(num_seq, num_res)` counting lowercase letters to the left of each position.
- Implement `sequences_are_feature_equivalent(seq1::String, seq2::String, chain_poly_type::String)::Bool`.
- Implement `parse_sequence_identifier(identifier::String)::String` extracting the UniProtKB species identifier from a sequence description using the pattern `tr|ID|ID_SPECIES` or `sp|ID|ID_SPECIES`.
- Implement `get_species_ids(descriptions::Vector{String})::Vector{String}`.
- Implement `compute_msa_profile(msa::Matrix{Int32}, num_residue_types::Int)::Matrix{Float64}` computing normalized residue frequency per position.

  - `name::String`

- Define `struct DnaChain` with fields: `id::String`, `sequence::String`.
- Define `struct Ligand` with fields: `id::String`, `ccd_ids::Union{Vector{String},Nothing}`, `smiles::Union{String,Nothing}`.

- Define `struct TokenFeatures` with fields: `aatype::Vector{Int32}`, `residue_index::Vector{Int32}`, `token_index::Vector{Int32}`, `seq_length::Int32`, `chain_index::Vector{Int32}`, `entity_id::Vector{Int32}`, `sym_id::Vector{Int32}`, `num_sym::Vector{Int32}`, `is_protein::Vector{Bool}`, `is_rna::Vector{Bool}`, `is_dna::Vector{Bool}`, `is_ligand::Vector{Bool}`.
- Define `struct RefStructure` with fields: `positions::Array{Float32,3}` (num_tokens × max_atoms_per_token × 3), `mask::Matrix{Float32}`, `element::Matrix{Int32}`, `charge::Matrix{Float32}`, `atom_name_chars::Array{Int32,3}`.
- Define `struct MSAFeatures` with fields: `rows::Matrix{Int32}`, `mask::Matrix{Float32}`, `deletion_matrix::Matrix{Float32}`, `profile::Matrix{Float32}`, `deletion_mean::Vector{Float32}`, `num_alignments::Int32`.
- Define `struct TemplateFeatures` with fields: `aatype::Array{Int32,3}`, `all_atom_positions::Array{Float32,5}`, `all_atom_mask::Array{Float32,4}`, `domain_names::Matrix{UInt8}`, `sequence::Matrix{UInt8}`, `sum_probs::Matrix{Float32}`.
- Define `struct Batch` with fields: `token_features::TokenFeatures`, `msa::MSAFeatures`, `templates::TemplateFeatures`, `ref_structure::RefStructure`, `polymer_ligand_bond_info`, `ligand_ligand_bond_info`, `pseudo_beta_info`, `atom_cross_att`, `frames`.

  - Tokenizes each chain (1 token per residue for polymers, 1 token per atom for ligands).

  - Computes inter-chain bonds (polymer-ligand and ligand-ligand) by distance thresholding.
  - Computes pseudo-beta positions (CB for non-GLY protein residues, CA for GLY, C4/C2 for nucleotides).

- Implement `create_msa_feat(batch::Batch)::Array{Float32,3}` building the MSA feature tensor.
- Implement `shuffle_msa(msa::MSAFeatures, rng)::MSAFeatures` randomly permuting MSA rows (keeping row 0 fixed).

## File 9: `network_modules.jl`

Implement all neural network building blocks using Flux.jl (or a pure-Julia autograd framework).

- Implement `LayerNorm(dim::Int; eps=1f-5, upcast=true)` — layer normalization with learnable scale and offset vectors; if `upcast=true`, cast Float16/BFloat16 inputs to Float32 before computing, then cast back.
- Implement `Linear(in_dim::Int, out_dim::Int; use_bias=true, initializer=:lecun_normal)` — linear layer with NTK-style initialization (scale by `1/sqrt(fan_in)`).
- Implement `Transition(dim::Int, num_intermediate_factor::Int)` — two-layer MLP with SiLU activation and layer norm.
- Implement `TriangleMultiplication(c_z::Int; equation::String)` — triangle multiplicative update. Support both `"kjc,kic->ijc"` (incoming) and `"ikc,jkc->ijc"` (outgoing) equations. Use gating with sigmoid.
- Implement `GridSelfAttention(c_z::Int, num_heads::Int; chunk_size=nothing)` — axial self-attention over pair representation (row-wise then column-wise), with pair bias.
- Implement `OuterProductMean(c_m::Int, c_z::Int, num_output_channel::Int)` — outer product mean from MSA to pair representation.
- Implement `MSARowAttentionWithPairBias(c_m::Int, c_z::Int, num_heads::Int)` — MSA row-wise attention with pair representation as bias.
- Implement `MSAColumnAttention(c_m::Int, num_heads::Int)` — MSA column-wise attention.
- Implement `PairFormerIteration(c_z::Int, c_s::Int, num_heads_pair::Int, num_heads_single::Int; num_layer::Int, shard_transition_blocks=true)` — one iteration of the PairFormer stack: triangle multiplication (outgoing), triangle multiplication (incoming), pair attention, pair transition, single attention (optional), single transition (optional).
- Implement `EvoformerIteration(c_m::Int, c_z::Int, c_s::Int)` — one iteration of the MSA stack: MSA row attention with pair bias, MSA column attention, MSA transition, outer product mean, then PairFormer operations.
- Implement `SelfAttention(c::Int, num_heads::Int; use_pair_bias=false)` — standard multi-head self-attention with optional pair bias, using AdaLN-zero conditioning.
- Implement `CrossAttention(c_q::Int, c_kv::Int, num_heads::Int)` — cross-attention between query and key/value sets.
- Implement `DiffusionTransformerBlock(c::Int, num_heads::Int, num_intermediate_factor::Int; use_pair_bias=false)` — transformer block with AdaLN-zero conditioning: layer norm conditioned on single embedding, self-attention, transition.
- Implement `CrossAttTransformerBlock(c_q::Int, c_kv::Int, num_heads::Int, num_intermediate_factor::Int)` — cross-attention transformer block.
- Implement `noise_embeddings(sigma_scaled_noise_level::AbstractArray{Float32})::AbstractArray{Float32}` — Fourier noise level embeddings: `(1/4) * log(sigma)`, then multiply by fixed weights and add fixed biases (256-dimensional), then `cos(2π * result)`. Use the fixed weight/bias arrays from the reference implementation.
- Implement `mask_mean(mask::AbstractArray, value::AbstractArray; dims=nothing, eps=1f-10)::AbstractArray` — masked mean with broadcast support.

## File 10: `evoformer.jl`

Implement the Evoformer module.

- Define `struct EvoformerConfig` with fields: `max_relative_chain::Int=2`, `msa_channel::Int=64`, `seq_channel::Int=384`, `max_relative_idx::Int=32`, `num_msa::Int=1024`, `pair_channel::Int=128`, `num_pairformer_layers::Int=48`, `num_msa_layers::Int=4`.
- Implement `struct Evoformer` containing:
  - Input projection layers for MSA (`c_m = msa_channel`), pair (`c_z = pair_channel`), single (`c_s = seq_channel`).
  - Relative position encoding embedding (linear from relative encoding dim to `c_z`).
  - MSA stack: `num_msa_layers` × `EvoformerIteration`.
  - PairFormer stack: `num_pairformer_layers` × `PairFormerIteration` (with single conditioning).
